summary: Mock / illustrative evidence shows a query-efficiency regression after a deployment marker.

sections.title: Query Efficiency Regression

facts.text: Request p95 increased from 200 ms to 1000 ms (400%).
The scan ratio increased from 20:1 to 4000:1.
The observed plan changed from IXSCAN to COLLSCAN.

hypothesis.text: Hypothesis: the changed query shape may no longer use the existing index effectively.

recommendedChecks: Compare the query shape before and after the deployment.
Run explain('executionStats') against a safe representative query.
limitations: Mock / illustrative data does not prove deployment causation.
All values are mock / illustrative; replace mock adapters for production evidence.
